content.short: Chapter One is a Santa Monica-based full-stack crypto fund dedicated to early-stage founders.
content.description: Chapter One, a Santa Monica, California-based venture capital firm established in 2017, focuses on investing in consumer-focused platforms and technologies within web3, fintech, and cryptocurrency. Beyond funding, it develops, builds, and incubates internet-based business models and provides operational and technical support to help its portfolio companies scale internationally. The firm is known for its hands-on startup-building capabilities, strategic guidance, and ability to generate business leads.
